examples.japanese: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧{警部|けいぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Inspector Tanaka was in charge of the investigation.

examples.japanese: {警部|けいぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だ。
examples.english: He was just promoted to inspector.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{警部|けいぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: The inspector who arrived at the crime scene immediately gave instructions to his subordinates.

notes:
A mid-ranking police officer title in the Japanese police hierarchy, roughly equivalent to 'inspector' in English. Very commonly encountered in crime fiction and detective dramas. Used as a title after a person's name (e.g., ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧{警部|けいぶ}).

JAPANESE POLICE RANKS (ascending):
- ⟦{巡査|じゅんさ}→巡査：04276_junsa⟧: patrol officer
- {巡査部長|じゅんさぶちょう}: sergeant
- ⟦{警部補|けいぶほ}→警部補：25615_keibuho⟧: assistant inspector
- {警部|けいぶ}: inspector
- {警視|けいし}: superintendent

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警部|けいぶ}{補|ほ}: assistant inspector (one rank below)
- ⟦{主任|しゅにん}→主任：08211_shunin⟧{警部|けいぶ}: senior inspector
- 〜{警部|けいぶ}: Inspector ~ (as title)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famous fictional inspectors include {古畑|ふるはた}{任三郎|にんざぶろう} and {杉下|すぎした}{右京|うきょう} from popular detective dramas.
